workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Silent-turn fallback records an upstream 429 as context_overflow and marks a retryable failure non-retryable
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(shared): classify silent-turn failures by reason code, not banner text. Target files: packages/shared/src/session-failure.ts, packages/shared/tests/session-failure.test.ts. A turn that ends with zero agent output (e.g. upstream provider keeps returning HTTP 429 until retries exhaust) is recorded as a failed turn via the `agent_no_output` path — which is correct. But `classifyFailureReason()` pattern-matched the notice `message` **before** looking at `notice.reason`. The message on that notice is Lody's own synthesized `SILEN... (Ref: https://github.com/LodyAI/Lody/pull/3291)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Agent sessions started by the desktop app inherit ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, so Electron apps launched by the agent start as plain Node.js
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): strip ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE from agent session env. Target files: apps/cli/src/agent/acp-runner.test.ts, apps/cli/src/agent/acp-runner.ts, apps/cli/src/session/session.ts. Desktop launches the bundled CLI under `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` (apps/electron/src/main/services/cli-service.ts:1252). Agent sessions spawned from it inherited the flag because the two agent-session env builders merge `process.env` and never stripped it — unlike the terminal-pty (`TERMINAL_ENV_BLOCKLIST`), daemon (`daemon-shared.ts`/`daemon-runner.ts`... (Ref: https://github.com/LodyAI/Lody/pull/3273)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Desktop onboarding login screen hides main-process browser sign-in failures
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(onboarding): surface main-process browser sign-in failures. Target files: apps/electron/src/main/application.ts, packages/components/src/components/onboarding/screens/login-screen.tsx, packages/components/tests/onboarding-flow.test.tsx. When a new desktop user opens Lody for the first time, the app launches `/onboarding` and presents `LoginScreen` (`packages/components/src/components/onboarding/screens/login-screen.tsx`) rather than `/login` (`LoginPage`). (Ref: https://github.com/LodyAI/Lody/pull/3188)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Claude Code quota stays stale behind an HTTP proxy in macOS 0.114.1
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): restore Claude quota refresh through proxies. Target files: apps/cli/vite.config.ts, apps/cli/tests/vite-config.test.ts. The packaged Claude quota client fails when a proxy tunnel negotiates HTTP/2. Rollup leaves Undici's guarded `require('node:http2')` in the ESM bundle, so `http2.connect` is unavailable and the UI can keep displaying an expired quota snapshot. (Ref: https://github.com/LodyAI/Lody/pull/3242)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Magpie catalog rejects vendor reasoning effort words, blocking all Magpie runtimes
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: accept Magpie vendor reasoning effort words in model catalog. Target files: apps/cli/src/agent/magpie-runtime.test.ts, apps/cli/src/agent/magpie-runtime.ts. `parseMagpieCatalog` validates `supported_reasoning_levels[].effort` against a closed enum of eight standard tiers. Magpie relays each model's reasoning levels in the vendor's own words — routing groups and plugins expose names like `light`, `balanced`, `deep`, `disabled`, and aliases such as `extra_high`. workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Monaco Find Widget tooltip flickers over buttons in narrow code views
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: prevent narrow Monaco Find tooltip flicker. Target files: packages/components/src/components/sessions/session-monaco-text-viewer.css, packages/components/src/components/sessions/session-monaco-text-viewer.tsx, packages/components/tests/e2e/code-collab-stories-smoke.spec.ts. In the 320 px Session Monaco surface, Monaco 0.55.1 wraps Find action tooltips back over their originating buttons. The tooltip then steals pointer hit-testing, so Monaco repeatedly tears it down and recreates it and the action becomes unreliable to click. (Ref: https://github.com/LodyAI/Lody/pull/750)
